title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover race and load-shedding thrash
author: Ethan Zhao
description: Motivation: In production we observed intermittent thrashing during regional failover where the SLO enforcer concurrently triggered load-shedding and cross-region failover decisions, leading to cascading circuit-breaker opens and customer-visible errors. This PR fixes a race in the SLO enforcer state machine and hardens failover/backoff ordering to prevent repeated failover attempts under transient errors. Summary of changes: 1) add a single-source-of-truth region state with compare-and-swap updates to prevent concurrent conflicting transitions; 2) decouple load-shedding triggers from immediate failover decisions by introducing a short hysteresis window and a tokenized backoff counter persisted to Redis; 3) tighten circuit-breaker open conditions to require both SLO breach and sustained queue growth for N seconds; 4) add unit and integration tests for race scenarios and introduce a new sanity e2e that replays incident traces. Rollout plan: feature flagged default-on for SRE org, gradual rollout over 6 hours with metrics monitored (slo.enforcer.failover.attempts, slo.enforcer.load_shed.events, slo.enforcer.cb_opens). Backout: roll back feature-flag if regression. Risk: medium - coordinated states touched in enforcer and routing; mitigations include thorough tests and a safety flag to disable new ordering. Related: ENG-4321 (investigate regional failover thrash), SUP-1192 (customer incident), ENG-4450 (circuit-breaker threshold tuning).

review_comments: Liam: Can you explain why CAS is necessary instead of using the existing leader election? Author: Leader election didn't prevent local concurrent transitions inside a control-plane replica - CAS ensures per-region linearizable transitions without forcing single-leader for the whole enforcer. Liam: ok after reading CAS code path.

Sofia: The hysteresis window looks arbitrary (5s). Can we base it on queue growth rate? Author: We compute a short default (5s) and scale with observed growth; added code comment and TODO to tune via metrics. Sofia: please add ops dashboard, done.
Alicia: Integration test flaked originally on CI due to timing; author: increased test timeouts and added deterministic clocks in test harness. Alicia: approved after CI green.
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover race and reduce load-shedding thrash. Improves regional failover ordering and reduces spurious circuit-breaker opens (affects routing decisions and enforcer state). Rollout via feature flag; recommended monitor slo.enforcer.failover.attempts and slo.enforcer.cb_opens.
